import.helpCsvStep1: Download the CSV template by clicking 'Download Template'

import.helpTvIntro: Automatically import trades from TradingView alerts:
import.helpTvStep1: Create an alert in TradingView for your strategy
import.helpTvStep2: In the alert settings, enable 'Webhook URL'
import.helpTvStep3: Copy your webhook URL from the 'Automatic Import via Webhook' section above
import.helpTvStep4: Paste the webhook URL and configure the message format with trade details
import.helpNtStep1: Download the NinjaTrader webhook script (coming soon)
import.helpNtStep2: Import the script into NinjaTrader (Tools > Import > NinjaScript)
import.helpNtStep3: Enable the strategy and configure your webhook URL
import.helpNtStep4: Trades will be automatically sent to your journal after each fill
import.helpWebhookInfo: Your personal webhook URL is displayed above. Keep this URL private as it provides direct access to your trading journal.
